verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs describe a 'skill' mechanism ('Write a skill when you notice yourself giving an agent the same correction twice') and an installed task-executor skill in the checkout, which loosely maps to encoding project-specific conventions for agents, but there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated context file (e.g., conventions.md) for describing codebase style/conventions. Missing for 10: explicit context-file feature, guidance on structuring codebase conventions, evidence that agents consume such a file specifically for improving plan/code relevance.
